title: A/P Detail: a vendor credit links to the return it came from
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has three unused vendor credits: {Vendor-credit-A} from a vendor return made at {Location-A}, {Vendor-credit-B} from a vendor return made at {Location-B}, and {Vendor-credit-C} not from a vendor return.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-07 Returns.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Detail is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Vendor-A} ticked and its rows showing.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the three vendor credits' numbers.
  2. Click {Vendor-credit-A}'s number.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Vendor-credit-A}'s number is a link; {Vendor-credit-B}'s (another location) and {Vendor-credit-C}'s (no vendor return) are plain text.
  • Step 2: the vendor return {Vendor-credit-A} came from opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R9: “On A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices, a vendor credit's number links to the vendor return it came from, under the same rules and permissions as a bill (S7-R6). A vendor credit that did not come from a vendor return shows as plain text.”
  • S7-R6: “A bill at the user's current location opens its delivery, as today. A bill at another location shows as plain text, because the bill page cannot switch location.”
